title: Puls Sync Protocol v1: batch header
description: The first line of every batch. The count fields declare exactly how many lines of each type follow, in the fixed order samples, deletions, routes, series, aggregates, activity summaries, profile. Unknown fields must be ignored.

schemaVersion.description: Protocol version of this batch. Absent means a client that predates versioning, which receivers treat as 1.

clientVersion.description: Free-form sender identification, e.g. PulsHealth/1.2.0 (build 57). Diagnostic only.

batchID.description: Stable per upload attempt: a retried upload re-sends the same batchID, so receivers may use it to short-circuit replays.

type.description: A label for the batch: the type identifier that contributed the most samples, or any non-empty string for a probe. Receivers must not derive sample types from it.

reason.description: What kind of sync produced the batch.

exportedAt.description: When the sender serialized the batch.

profileCount.description: 0 or 1: at most one profile line per batch.

count.description: Number of lines of one type that follow the header. Absent means 0. The reference server rejects any single count above 100,000 and a combined total above 200,000.
